description: Chief Secretariate's Office - Central Province - Central Province Provincial Council on 21.02.2017 under section 125 of the said Act, read together with section (3) of section z of the Provincial Coucils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the approval and publication of By-laws for Pradeshiya Sabhas (local councils) in the Central Province. It references specific legislative acts (Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 and Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989) and details the legal process for their enactment. The core content is about establishing regulatory frameworks and legal procedures, not about government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories like land or commerce. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks."
